OPERATIVE REPORT

Procedure: Aortic valve replacement with tissue prosthesis via full sternotomy.

The patient presented with symptomatic severe aortic stenosis and was referred for surgical
aortic valve replacement after heart team review. Cardiopulmonary bypass was instituted and
the calcified native valve was excised. The annulus accommodated a #21 Trifecta valve,
which was implanted using interrupted pledgeted sutures in the supra-annular position.

Replacement Type: Tissue
Tissue Implant Type: Bioprosthesis, externally mounted pericardial
Implant Size: 21

Hemodynamic assessment after separation from bypass showed the mean gradient is 8 mmHg
across the prosthetic valve with a dimensionless valve index of 0.48. No significant
regurgitation was seen. The chest was closed in routine fashion over mediastinal drains.
